about:
Sandridge Crafted Foods traces its roots to 1960 when Vincent R. Sandridge began selling vacuum-packed deli meats in Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio. The company, now headquartered in Morton, Illinois, remains a third-generation, family-owned operation. Vincent’s son Mark D. Sandridge joined in 1976, later purchasing the business in 1997 and expanding into kettle-cooked soups, sauces, and sous vide proteins. Today, Mark’s sons Jordan and Dane serve as co-presidents, steering the business alongside nearly 1,000 employees across multiple facilities.

The company produces chef-crafted fresh foods including deli salads, soups, sauces, sous vide proteins, and assembled meal kits. Core technologies include high-pressure processing (HPP) for preservative-free shelf-life extension, European-inspired kettle cooking for layered flavors, and precision sous vide cooking. A 2023-opened Center of Excellence in Medina, Ohio, houses a culinary R&D team that runs a “bench-to-box” development process. Facilities also feature blanching systems, vegetable prep lines, and cold-chain logistics managed through sister company MDS Inc.

Sandridge serves college and university dining, deli and prepared-food retailers, foodservice distributors, and healthcare operators. Its branded lines—Grandma’s®, Melch’s®, and the new Simply Crafted™—appear in retail and foodservice channels, while private-label and co-pack programs supply custom formulations for national and regional brands.

The founding vision centered on fresh, authentic food that fosters community. Leadership emphasizes culinary innovation backed by food-science rigor, a GFSI/SQFI-certified safety program, and a vertically integrated cold chain to deliver “remarkably fresh” products without artificial preservatives.
